python3 - <<'PY'
import json, urllib.request, pathlib
cfg = json.loads(pathlib.Path('.claude/database/dc-platform.json').read_text())
base = cfg['base_url'].rstrip('/')
token = cfg['token']
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}

def req(method, path, body=None):
    data = None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode()
    r = urllib.request.Request(base+path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r, timeout=60) as resp:
            return resp.status, json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return e.code, e.read().decode()[:1000]

# inspect index row fully for these codes
st, body = req('GET', '/api/v1/dev-sessions/index?scope=mine&project_id=dmp/dc-parent')
items = body.get('items') or body.get('data') or body
if isinstance(body, dict) and 'items' not in body and 'data' not in body:
    # maybe list under another key
    print('body keys', body.keys())
    items = body.get('sessions') or list(body.values())[0] if body else []
for it in (items if isinstance(items, list) else []):
    c = it.get('code','')
    if c in ('dev-20261016-013','dev-20261013-001','dev-20261013-002','dev-20261013-003','dev-20261022-001'):
        # print all keys that look publish-related
        interesting = {k:v for k,v in it.items() if any(x in k.lower() for x in ['publish','review','assign','stage','status','pending'])}
        print('\n', c)
        print(json.dumps(interesting, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)[:1200])

# also try GET pending reviews / publish queue
for path in [
  '/api/v1/dev-sessions/publish-requests?scope=mine',
  '/api/v1/dev-sessions/pending-reviews',
  '/api/v1/dev-sessions/index?scope=pending_review',
]:
    st, b = req('GET', path)
    print('\nGET', path, st, str(b)[:200] if not isinstance(b,dict) else list(b.keys())[:10])
PY
